defaults.card_verse:
The years keep on turning, the seasons move on,
but love doesn't notice when someone has gone.
So happy birthday, wherever you are;
you're never not with us, you're never too far.

We set out your picture, we light up the cake,
and make every wish that we know you would make.
Heaven is lucky to have you today,
but we have the memories no one can take away.

No card can be mailed, no call can get through,
so we send up this wish and a candle for you:
happy birthday in heaven, from all of us here,
who carry you with us through every new year.

Today isn't only for missing you, Mom;
it's for cake and your songs and the things you would do.
We laugh at your stories, we say them again,
and we'll keep on celebrating you, now and then.

Happy birthday in heaven. We hold what you taught:
to love without measure, to give without thought.
The candle is lit and your chair is still here;
you are loved and remembered, this and every year.
